test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'carrying on'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about 'The East India Company'.
 
• In the given blank, the most appropriate phrasal verb is **'carrying on'.**
 
• It means** '**continue an activity or task​ (एक गतिविधि या कार्य जारी रखना)'.
 
 
• *Example: She **carried on **watching the TV.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Eighty merchants of London came together in the year 1600 __to form__ (1) the East India Company. They wanted to enter *__*into*__* **(2)** business with Indian traders in the fields of textile and spices. They __were__ **(3) **inspired by the Portuguese and the Dutch who were __**carrying on**__ **(4)** a flourishing trade in spices and earning huge (5) _____.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Setting about:** To start doing something with vigor or determination. (किसी कार्य को प्रारंभ करना)
 
• **Pulling on:** To put on clothing, usually quickly or with some effort. (जल्दी या प्रयास के साथ पहनना)
 
• **Getting out: **To leave or escape from a place or situation. (बाहर निकलना)

47:Taa1,

The correct answer is '**profits**'.
